description: Guide a student through researching a Bollinger Band mean-reversion signal on BTC in Python, backtesting it to get preliminary metrics, then implementing the same strategy as a LEAN C# algorithm and comparing results across backends.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I've been reading about Bollinger Bands and mean reversion. I want to try building a strategy that buys BTC when it drops below the lower band. Can you help me prototype it in Python first, and then maybe implement it in C# for the LEAN engine?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I want to prototype a BB(20,2) mean-reversion strategy on BTC in Python, get baseline metrics, then implement the same logic in LEAN C#. I want to compare the Python and LEAN backtests to make sure they agree. Where do we start?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm building a Bollinger Band mean-reversion strategy for BTCUSDT. The workflow is: prototype in Python to validate the signal, then port to LEAN C# for production-grade backtest with proper order execution. I need the two backends to produce comparable results. Let's architect this systematically.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student prototypes a BB(20,2) mean-reversion strategy in Python with Sharpe/return/drawdown metrics, then implements the same logic in LEAN C# producing a successful backtest, and compares results across both backends.
required_capabilities: Define Bollinger Band signal parameters in Python
Run a Python backtest and extract performance metrics
Implement equivalent strategy in LEAN C#
Compile and run LEAN backtest successfully
Compare Python vs LEAN results and discuss discrepancies
